objective: Qualify the existing ED compatibility boundary against the retained pre-extraction nominal output: assert exact serialized bytes for the unchanged version-1 scenario, version-3 capacity profile, and version-1 run document. Keep schema migration policy separate and make no public schema or fixture changes.
steps: Add a focused compatibility test that reads the immutable historical nominal output, runs the unchanged current scenario through the public ED run adapter using the recorded input-file label, and compares complete serialized JSON bytes.
Assert the current nominal input bytes retain the hash recorded by the historical run; no historical evidence is rewritten.

Document the existing ED-to-core adapter boundary and separately enumerate current scenario, capacity/location, run-document, and Arrow schema versions and the explicit no-migration decision for this slice.
Run the exact focused native test and record source/input/output hashes and command outcomes.

verification.oracle: The test executes and the current RunDocument serialization equals retained baseline bytes exactly.

acceptance: The exact historical nominal run document matches byte-for-byte at the current ED compatibility boundary.
The public input and output schema versions remain unchanged, and no migration is silently implied.
Schema evolution policy is documented independently from runtime fixture parity.
No clinical validity, full ED-to-ward/community composition, or hosted CI acceptance is claimed by A6.1.
stop_conditions: The fixture or schema is changed
An existing adapter contract is missing or ambiguous
Any edit escapes the listed write paths
